author: ColdBurst
quote: I never played the N64 or 3DS version so I went into this with no expectations. From the boss fights, the side quests, the clever secrets hidden in the world, the story and also the visuals (for a Switch 2), this game is absolutely amazing. Will it win GOTY? Probably not. Do I consider it to be my favourite game of all time? Probably not. Is it an excellent game? A resounding YES!
